name: Go Fish
tagline: Ask for the cards you need and collect books of four. Great with kids.

options.label: Play until every book is made

rulesSummary: Collect books: all four cards of a rank. Five cards each; the rest make the pond.
On your turn, pick a card from your hand and ask another player for that rank. If they have any, they hand them all over and you ask again.
If not, “Go fish!”: draw from the pond. Drew the rank you asked for? Go again. Otherwise the turn passes left.
A book goes down as soon as you hold all four.
The game ends when anyone runs out of cards or the pond runs dry. Most books wins; a tie shares the win.
Play until every book is made (a lobby option): an empty hand draws five more, and once the pond is empty a wrong guess just passes the turn.
Two players get seven cards each.
